notes.title: From Pixelatl to Pan Dulce: Big Updates!
notes.content:
[p]¡Hola panaderos! It’s been a busy (and delicious) few weeks for the team. Here’s a look at what we’ve been cooking up![/p][p][/p][h3][b]On the Road with PancitoMerge[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We just came back from [b]Pixelatl (Sept 9-13, Guadalajara, México)[/b] where we had the amazing opportunity to show our game off! It was SO fun seeing players spend time in our little bakery. In the sea of noise and chaos at these conventions it’s nice that players can find our cozy game and relax in our bakery. Some of them didn’t even want to put the controller down, which is the best case scenario we could have imagined! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584647/1ac0368d083b9defb380b4bab20067265cda4868.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now we’re also part of Steam events like [b]MES (Mexican Entertainment System), GDCoE, and Six One Indie[/b]. If you spotted us there, thanks for stopping by! (and please wishlist, it helps us so much!)[/p][p][/p][h3]💀 [b]New “Día de Muertos” Bakery[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584647/145df60b05bc3ac286c757109553644b5188f8b5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now for the really REALLY exciting stuff (that stuff before was regular exciting hehe). We’re excited to reveal our next level: a bakery inspired by [b]Día de Muertos[/b]. Expect a spooky-but-cozy vibe with [b]new breads, festive decorations, and some curious customers[/b] joining your shop. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Demo Update[/b]
[/h3][p][/p][p]That's just some of what is to come but here's what you can enjoy right now! The demo got some extra love:[/p][list][*][p]Runs smoother [/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes [/p][/*][*][p]Extra juice & polish for that oh-so-satisfying bouncy bread feel[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What’s Next[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re headed to [b]Super Nova[/b] in Mexico City on Oct 4th - stop by our booth and say hi! (and also play our game!)

We're also hard at work on the [b]third bakery[/b]. It’s going to be special so stay tuned for those tasty updates.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting PancitoMerge every wishlist, playtest, and comment helps us bake the game into something truly sweet.[/p]
